markets.title: India Juggles Growth, Budget Deficit as Global Risks Mount
markets.description: India’s finance minister unveiled a relatively cautious budget on Sunday, focusing on economic stability in the face of rising global risks.

markets.title: Euro Rally Is Latest Risk to ECB’s Inflation Outlook
markets.description: The surge in the euro is set to loom large over the European Central Bank’s first policy meeting of the year.

markets.title: OPEC+ on Track to Ratify March Output Pause, Delegates Say
markets.description: OPEC+ is on track to ratify its plans to pause production increases in March, delegates said ahead of the group’s online meeting on Sunday.

markets.title: Saudi Oil-Supply Hikes Power Best Economic Growth Since 2022
markets.description: Saudi Arabia’s economy expanded at the fastest pace in three years in 2025, with the oil sector emerging as a stronger engine of growth under new OPEC+ supply policy.

markets.title: India’s Plan to Hike Tax on Equity Derivatives Jolts Market
markets.description: Indian equities slumped after the government said it plans to raise taxes on equity derivatives trades, doubling down on efforts to curb speculative activity among retail investors.

markets.title: NCC Said in Talks to Sell Industry Unit to CRH-Heidelberg Group
markets.description: Nordic construction firm NCC AB is in advanced talks to sell its industry business to a consortium including CRH Plc and Heidelberg Materials AG, two of the world’s biggest building materials companies, according to people familiar with the matter.

markets.title: India Cuts Taxes to Boost Rare Earth Processing to Counter China
markets.description: India is looking to remove taxes on import of equipment for processing critical minerals and spur manufacturing of rare earth magnets locally, a move aimed at minimizing dependence on China.

markets.title: India to Double Tax Holiday in Finance Hub to Boost Business
markets.description: India will extend a tax holiday at its international finance hub to boost the appeal for businesses setting up shop there.

markets.title: India Proposes New Incentives to Boost Municipal Bond Market
markets.description: The Indian government proposed fresh steps to boost the nation’s municipal bond market and encourage civic bodies to issue higher value debt as rising urban infrastructure needs weigh on the federal government’s budget.

markets.title: India Seeks Diaspora Capital as Foreign Funds Pull Out of Local Stocks
markets.description: India is seeking to draw more money from its overseas nationals into local equities as global funds pull back amid concerns over corporate earnings and more attractive returns elsewhere.

markets.title: India’s Record $187 Billion Debt Sales Add Pressure to Bonds
markets.description: Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s government plans to sell a record amount of bonds in the coming fiscal year, a move that risks adding further pressure to local debt markets amid waning demand.

markets.title: Saudi Stocks Slide Most Since June on Geopolitics, Gold Retreat
markets.description: Saudi Arabian equities dropped the most in almost eight months on Sunday as a global metals selloff hit local miners and speculation intensified over the possibility of military attacks involving the US, Iran and Israel.

markets.title: India Extends Import Tax Waivers on Nuclear Equipment Until 2035
markets.description: India will continue to offer the existing tax waivers for imports of nuclear power equipment until 2035, regardless of the size of the projects, Finance Minister Nirmala Sitharaman said in her budget speech on Sunday.

markets.title: India Expects Another Record Dividend Payout From Central Bank
markets.description: India expects to receive a record 3.16 trillion rupees ($34.4 billion) in dividends from its central bank and state-owned financial institutions in the fiscal year starting in April, according to budget documents tabled in the Parliament on Sunday.

markets.title: India Ramps Up Infrastructure Spending in $130 Billion Budget Push
markets.description: India plans to invest 12.2 trillion rupees ($133 billion) in infrastructure in the next financial year, about a 9% increase from last year, as Prime Minister Narendra Modi’s government steps up spending to accelerate an overhaul of transport and logistics networks.

markets.title: Bitcoin’s Break Below $80,000 Signals New Crisis of Confidence
markets.description: Price, relevance, conviction — Bitcoin is bleeding all three.

markets.title: Regulating Africa’s Expanding Gambling Market
markets.description: Africa is emerging as a major betting powerhouse, but governments across the continent are struggling to keep pace with the regulatory challenges rising alongside it. Bloomberg’s Jennifer Zabasajja spoke with RISE Mzansi MP Makashule Gana and Garron Whitesman, founder of Whitesmans Attorneys, about the current regulatory landscape and the pressure to strengthen oversight. (Source: Bloomberg)

markets.title: Macau Gaming Revenue Beats Estimate on Entertainment Offerings
markets.description: Macau’s gaming revenue rose 24% in January, beating analyst estimates as casinos in the world’s biggest gambling hub continued to rely on perks like free concert tickets and entertainment offerings to lure high-spending travelers.

markets.title: Japan’s Takaichi Clarifies Weak Yen Remarks From Election Rally
markets.description: Japanese Prime Minister Sanae Takaichi sought to clarify her comments about the weak yen, emphasizing that she only intended to argue for a need to create an economy that can withstand currency fluctuations.

markets.title: Indonesian Coal Association Says Quota Cuts Risks Mine Shutdowns
markets.description: The Indonesian Coal Miners Association said drastic cuts in production quotas granted by the government may force some operations to shutdown, adding to the woes of the country’s already beleaguered industry.

technology.title: Indian Electronics Manufacturing Shares Rise on Budget Boost
technology.description: Shares of some Indian electronics manufacturing services companies ended higher in Sunday trading after the finance minister set aside 400 billion rupees ($4.3 billion) to boost the sector and position the country as a global hub for the sector.

technology.title: OpenAI Investment Was ‘Never a Commitment,’ Nvidia’s Huang Says
technology.description: Nvidia Corp. Chief Executive Officer Jensen Huang said the company’s proposed $100 billion investment in OpenAI was “never a commitment” and that the company would consider any funding rounds “one at a time.”

technology.title: India Unveils 20-Year Tax Break to Woo Global Data Centers

technology.title: Indonesia Permits Elon Musk’s Grok to Resume Service After Ban
technology.description: Indonesia has permitted the artificial intelligence tool Grok to resume service after Elon Musk’s X provided assurances to the government following its ban for producing sexualized content.

technology.title: Nvidia CEO Says New OpenAI Investment May Be Largest Yet
